title: EXPLOITING THE ADHD DISABILITY
body: This app preys on the exact weaknesses of ppl with adhd while posing as a tool recommended by professionals. Instant popups for extra offers charge your card without a second confirmation after you agree to a free trial. The app itself is a pile of garbage. Be ashamed, you are absolutely disgusting and revolting to attack people at risk in this way.
author: Kapkaupunki

title: 🚩⛔️Confusing and BUSY UI , counterproductive for ADHD patients ! and PREDATORY BILLING PRACTICES ⛔️
body:
Absolutely useless overwhelming app , CLEARLY not science backed ! Notorious for PREDATORY BILLING PRACTICES according to ALL ADHD support and discussion forums online ! 

It is very telling that pricing subscriptions do not appear on the iOS AppStore which allows for billing to be handled with one click !
author: MrPleaser

title: Avoid at all costs, even a trial!
body: This app (as well as all Fabulous apps) is a total scam! I had no idea my trial cancellation did not go through, so i got charged 36.99 (no notification about it), and not once, but twice in one day! One was for the Clarify premium, and the second charge of 36.99 was for some Bundle Premium (huh?). Jeez. Never never again.
author: Anna11009988
